# Rithy Martial & Fitness — AI Knowledge & LLM Context File
> Premier Cambodian Martial Arts & High-Performance Athletic Training Center in Phnom Penh.

## Summary & Core Identity
- **Organization Name**: Rithy Martial & Fitness (RTY FITNESS)
- **Founder & Master Trainer**: Mr. Ny Rithy (Bokator Master, Kun Khmer Certified Referee, ISSA Strength & Conditioning Specialist)
- **Primary Mission**: Preserve 1,000-year-old Cambodian martial arts heritage (Bokator, Yuthakram Khom, Pradal Serey/Kun Khmer) while providing modern athletic fitness & BJJ training.
- **Location**: Phnom Penh, Cambodia
- **Phone / Telegram**: +855 12 345 678 | @rithymartialfitness
- **Website**: https://rtyfitness.riththydragon.site
